name: Louisbourg Lighthouse
scope: The first French Louisbourg lighthouse with its original timber lantern, before the September 1736 fire.
era: Original lantern in service from 1 April 1734 to September 1736.

references.artist: attribution à Verrier - Archives nationales d'outre-mer (France)

originalReview.notes: Original plan sheet marked 1733 and 172.B, exact published Qualla bytes and original Commons media, matched to the joint LAC/ANOM archival record. The reference shows the original wood lantern and its glazing.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with the original drawing already published by Qualla. Verified exact Commons bytes, its original public-domain record and the matching LAC/ANOM catalogue shelfmark. The catalogue dates the drawing 1732, while its title and inked date identify the scheduled 1733 work. No supplemental imagery used.
